app/js/facemesh-data.js holds the canonical face mesh's texture coordinates and triangles, read
out of face_landmarker.task by tools/canon-mesh.py (same licence).

They are self-hosted because the page loads them at run time with fetch(), and some hosts
(such as the Claude artifact viewer) only allow those requests to the page's own origin.
